source={
 'TL':[(4,7),(5,6),(5,7),(6,6),(6,7),(7,7),(7,8),(8,7),(8,8)],
 'TR':[(6,10),(7,10),(8,10),(8,11)],

 'BR':[(10,10),(12,10),(12,11),(12,12),(12,13),(13,12),(13,13)]
}

for r in (7,8,12): out[r][9]=7
for c in (8,10): out[9][c]=7
# Move quadrants, anchoring each piece's bounding box to its board corner.
def move(cells, top, left):
    rmin=min(r for r,c in cells); rmax=max(r for r,c in cells)
    cmin=min(c for r,c in cells); cmax=max(c for r,c in cells)
    dr=(0-rmin) if top else (n-1-rmax)
    dc=(0-cmin) if left else (n-1-cmax)
    return [(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in cells]
for key, cells in source.items():
    top=key[0]=='T'; left=key[1]=='L'
    dest=move(cells,top,left)
    for r,c in dest:
        assert 0<=r<n and 0<=c<n, (key,r,c)
        out[r][c]=7
